title: feat: implement @objectstack/service-analytics with multi-driver strategy pattern
body:
Analytics only had `MemoryAnalyticsService` — no path to Postgres/Mongo/SQL-backed aggregation. This adds `@objectstack/service-analytics` as the production `IAnalyticsService` implementation with driver-aware strategy dispatch.

### Architecture

- **AnalyticsService** — Orchestrator that walks a priority-ordered strategy chain:
  - **P1 NativeSQLStrategy** — Pushes native SQL to SQL-capable drivers (Postgres, MySQL)
  - **P2 ObjectQLStrategy** — Translates to `engine.aggregate()` AST for any ObjectQL driver
  - **P3 FallbackDelegateStrategy** (internal) — Auto-added when `fallbackService` is configured; delegates to any pre-registered `IAnalyticsService`
- **InMemoryStrategy** — Defined in `@objectstack/driver-memory` (not in service-analytics), for explicit use with the memory driver
- **Strategy contract types** (`AnalyticsStrategy`, `StrategyContext`, `DriverCapabilities`) — Defined in `@objectstack/spec/contracts/analytics-service.ts` following Protocol First principle
- **CubeRegistry** — Collects cube definitions from manifests + auto-infers from object schemas (numeric → sum/avg measures, date → time dimensions)
- **AnalyticsServicePlugin** — Kernel plugin lifecycle; auto-detects pre-registered analytics service as fallback via `replaceService`. Analytics service registration is owned by `service-analytics`, not by any driver.
- **DriverCapabilities** probing (`nativeSql`, `objectqlAggregate`, `inMemory`) drives strategy selection at runtime

### Usage

```ts
const kernel = new LiteKernel();
kernel.use(new AnalyticsServicePlugin({
  cubes: [ordersCube],
  queryCapabilities: () => ({ nativeSql: true, objectqlAggregate: true, inMemory: false }),
  executeRawSql: (obj, sql, params) => pgPool.query(sql, params).then(r => r.rows),
}));
await kernel.bootstrap();

const analytics = kernel.getService<IAnalyticsService>('analytics');
await analytics.query({ cube: 'orders', measures: ['orders.count'], dimensions: ['orders.status'] });
await analytics.generateSql({ cube: 'orders', measures: ['orders.total_amount'] }); // dry-run
```

### Files

- `packages/services/service-analytics/` — Orchestrator, NativeSQLStrategy, ObjectQLStrategy, cube registry, plugin, barrel exports
- `packages/plugins/driver-memory/src/in-memory-strategy.ts` — InMemoryStrategy (moved here from service-analytics per architectural feedback)
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts` — Strategy contract types added alongside IAnalyticsService
- 30 unit tests in service-analytics covering strategy branches, registry inference, orchestrator fallback chain
- `ROADMAP.md` — Analytics service status updated from 🟡 → ✅
- `CHANGELOG.md` — Documented under `[Unreleased]`

> <issue_title>实现 service-analytics，支持多数据库驱动的分析服务</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 背景
> 当前 ObjectStack 的 analytics 接口仅有 MemoryAnalyticsService 实现，无法支撑 PostgreSQL/Mongo/SQL 驱动的多数据源分析能力。
> 
> ## 目标
> - 在 `packages/services/service-analytics` 下实现标准化 `service-analytics` 插件。
> - 提供 IAnalyticsService 的完整实现，支持基于任意 Driver（Postgres、Mongo、Memory）进行分析聚合。
> - 支持自动发现和注册 Cube（支持 manifest 中明确定义和自动从对象推导）。
> - 通过策略模式（Strategy Pattern）根据 driver 能力动态下发分析查询（ObjectQL、原生 SQL、Memory 等）。
> - 提供原生 SQL 解释/生成能力（generateSql）。
> 
> ## 关键方案
> - 架构分离：AnalyticsService 仅为 orchestrator，实际执行通过策略链（Strategy 模式）委托给不同的实现
>     - P1：NativeSQLStrategy（优先下推原生 SQL）
>     - P2：ObjectQLStrategy（通用逻辑在 driver 支持时回落）
>     - P3：InMemoryStrategy（只限于 Memory/Dev 环境）
> - CubeRegistry 自动收集全部 cubes，支持多 manifest 来源
> - 完善跨驱动能力探测（queryAggregations），以适配当前和未来的多种存储后端
> - 确保与 API 协议 / Kernel 插件机制一致对齐
> - 
> ## 验收标准
> - [ ] 可以通过 objectql+postgres 或 objectql+mongo 驱动完成 /api/v1/analytics/query 查询（聚合、分组、过滤）
> - [ ] 各驱动的聚合能力可动态探测与切换
> - [ ] dev/test 环境继续兼容 MemoryAnalyticsService ��为
> - [ ] 有单元测试覆盖主要策略分支
> - [ ] ROADMAP.md、CHANGELOG.md 更新
